svg.text: s2d_pad_esd: the protection left standing in the s2d pad template (layout/klayout/template, version 4)
Devices and values as drawn and as extracted with IHP's KLayout LVS (template/lvs/template_extracted.cir on the notes branch).
They are IHP's IOPadAnalog protection without its SecondaryProtection: DCNDiode, DCPDiode, Clamp_N20N0D, Clamp_P20N0D.
DN1/2, DP1/2: the primary diodes, 2 stripes of 1.26 x 27.78 um each (DCNDiode / DCPDiode). They carry the ESD current pad -> iovss and pad -> iovdd.
MCN, MCP: the clamps, 20 hv NMOS fingers 4.4/0.6 and 20 x 2 hv PMOS fingers 6.66/0.6, drains on the pad (1.18 um drain ballast).
RN (1959 Ohm), RP (6768 Ohm): the "0D" gate tie-off of IHP's Clamp_N20N0D / Clamp_P20N0D (XR0 in sg13cmos5l_io.spice). Each holds its clamp's gate
at the clamp's own source rail, so the clamp is off in operation and the pad sees only drain junctions. Reasoning, not documented by IHP: the tie goes
through a resistor and not a wire so that a fast ESD edge, coupled through the gate-drain capacitance, lifts the gate for about R x C_gate and turns the
clamp on (gate-coupled triggering), and the gate oxide does not sit directly on a rail node during a CDM event.
Difference to IHP: RP lies on the substrate here (body iovss, the p-substrate as LVS extracts it); in IHP's cell its body is iovdd. Not drawn: the ptap1 "resistors" XR1 of IHP's spice
(iovss - sub!, about 10 Ohm) are the substrate taps of the guard rings, extracted as devices, not resistors anyone drew.
Since 2026-11-04 (C3 backannotation) the pad sheet sg13cmos5l_IOPadSingle2Diff instantiates this cell as xp, as the primary protection as drawn; no secondary protection.
